preparationDecision.limitsClause: Strict saga/inbox absence versus swallowed read errors needs an adequate public owner contract before source admission; name/register any genuine extra owner/test/roadmap leaves, no foreign SQL or invented availability.

reason.finding: The only by-outcome public saga reader, readCoordinatedCorrectionSagaByOutcomeId, returns null for an absent table, an absent row and every read failure alike. The other public reader, readCoordinatedCorrectionSaga, needs a matchId the inbox row does not carry and migrates schema as a side effect. P2CB therefore cannot separate known absence from hidden read failure without an owner-side strict reader, and the accepted review forbids foreign saga SQL or an invented distinction. Inbox, head/branch, match handle and manifest strictness fit inside the existing named P2CB leaves.
